fusions.name: Gnawing Pound
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up. Pounds the target for 7 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 0.8 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Pest Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 4 gnawing pests at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 poison damage with a 35% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Last Off the Ship
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Survivor's Share
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
